top_signals.title: Higher Prices Test Holiday Shoppers
top_signals.summary: Holiday sales are expected to rise this season, but inflation means shoppers may be spending more without bringing home more goods, while value and convenience remain key drivers. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Retail Analyst Poonam Goyal tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini how AI is reshaping shopping and helping consumers search for products, track prices and find deals. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
